annotations.title: Solana SPL Token Metadata, Decimals & Authority Registry Lookup

description: Retrieves canonical Solana SPL token metadata including name, ticker symbol, decimal precision, and current mint/freeze authority addresses. Use when resolving SPL token decimals, ticker symbols, and registry metadata for portfolio or swap formatting; for computing a composite security risk score and binary should_transact verdict, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'mint' ('network' defaults to 'mainnet-beta'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

mint.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL token mint address (e.g. 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v').

network.description: Solana cluster to query; defaults to 'mainnet-beta' when omitted.

name: inspect_solana_token_liquidity

authorities_renounced.description: True when both mint_authority and freeze_authority are null.

decimals.description: Token decimal precision used for raw lamport/atomic unit conversion.

mint.description: Queried Base58 SPL token mint address.

title: Solana SPL Token Metadata, Decimals & Authority Registry Lookup
